description: CrackAirport: A dataset for segmentation for airport pavements in General Aviation is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Zefeng Lyu. CrackAirport features images containing unique elements such as aircraft, T-hangars, vegetation, airport markings and signs, as well as evidence of previous maintenance. The dataset was captured using a Sony ILCE-7RM4A camera mounted on a drone flying at an altitude of 100 feet AGL. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
